{{about|the fraction|the band from South Carolina|Hundredth (band)|other uses|100th (disambiguation)}}
In [[arithmetic]], a '''hundredth''' is a single part of something that has been divided equally into a hundred parts.<ref>{{cite news |title=Meaning of hundredth |url=https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/hundredth |website=Cambridge Dictionary |access-date=31 March 2024}}</ref>  For example, a hundredth of 675 is 6.75. In this manner it is used with the prefix "[[centi-]]" such as in [[centimeter]]. A hundredth is also one [[percent]].

A hundredth is the [[multiplicative inverse|reciprocal]] of 100.

A hundredth is written as a [[decimal fraction]] as 0.01, and as a [[vulgar fraction]] as 1/100.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Hundredth |url=https://www.math.net/hundredth |access-date=2024-03-31 |website=Math.net}}</ref>

“Hundredth” is also the [[ordinal number]] that follows “ninety-ninth” and precedes “hundred and first.” It is written as 100th.
